source: Hacker's Delight, 2nd ed. (H. S. Warren), section 3-2 "Rounding Up/Down to the Next Power of 2"
description: Round up to the next power of 2 by smearing x - 1 right with or-shifts, then adding 1
notes: Classic or-shift smear (also Bit Twiddling Hacks #RoundUpPowerOf2); function written by us from the idea. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps the 5 shift/or pairs: 13 IR instructions. Candidate: a ctlz-based form, but it must keep the results at x = 0 and x > 2^31 (both 0 here), which the bit_ceil form of llvm/llvm-project#61644 does not. Unverified.
